description:
You are an online merchant setting up your WooCommerce store for launch. Your fulfillment partner charges a flat $8.50 per shipment anywhere in the United States.

Create a new shipping zone with the following configuration:

- Zone Name: Continental US
- Zone Region: United States (US)
- Shipping Method: Flat rate
- Flat Rate Cost: 8.50

You are currently on the WooCommerce Shipping Settings page in the WordPress admin dashboard. Click 'Add shipping zone' to begin, configure the zone name and region, add a Flat Rate shipping method, set its cost to 8.50, and save all changes.

IMPORTANT: The zone name must be exactly 'Continental US'. The region must include 'United States (US)'. The flat rate cost must be exactly 8.50 (no dollar sign in the field).
